metadata.boundary: Create-only content-addressed whole-source artifact path produced by T007 from the exact reviewed final source-integration revision containing T001, T002 and T005 changes and consumed by T003. Its manifest binds Git commit/tree identity, archive/content digest, Control Release Set and lock/input identity. T003 needs only this leased immutable artifact path plus its disposable storage sandbox and read-only host evidence; it does not read the Heim-PC Git object store or mutable checkout.
